name: Kokonoe Touko
source: Keisuke's older sister through adoption. Originally a distant relative, Keisuke's parents took Touko into their care after her parents died. Touko is a delicate and kind-hearted person who was Keisuke's first love, but she was involved in a certain case six years ago...
